MODL.name: Model
MODL.note: The model, with the MODT and MODS fields.

VMAD.name: Script Data
VMAD.note: The script data. Its size varies with the script.

DUAL.name: Dual
DUAL.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/DUAL. [measured: 2 DATA fields in Skyrim.esm, each 24 bytes]

DATA.name: Data
DATA.note: The projectile, explosion, effect shader, hit effect art and impact data set, and the scale inheritance flags.

DATA.name: Data

EQUP.name: Equipment
EQUP.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/EQUP. [measured: 7 DATA fields in Skyrim.esm, each 4 bytes]

FULL.name: Full Name
FULL.note: The name shown in the game.

EXPL.name: Explosion
EXPL.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/EXPL. [measured: 143 DATA fields in Skyrim.esm, 40, 44, 48 or 52 bytes]

DATA.name: Data
DATA.note: The explosion's data. Its layout is not documented.

MODL.name: Model
MODL.note: The model, with the MODT and MODS fields.

OBND.name: Object Bounds
OBND.note: Always 12 bytes, even when all zero.

FSTS.name: Footstep Set
FSTS.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/FSTS. [measured: 35 XCNT fields in Skyrim.esm, each 20 bytes]

DATA.name: Footstep Sets
DATA.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/FSTS. The footsteps, end to end. The count is the sum of the five sets' counts.

XCNT.name: Set Count
XCNT.note: The count of each of the five footstep sets.

LCTN.name: Location
LCTN.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/LCTN. [measured: 12 NAM0 and 9 FNAM fields in Skyrim.esm, each 4 bytes]

FULL.name: Full Name
FULL.note: The name shown in the game.

KWDA.name: Keyword
KWDA.note: A KYWD record. There is one per KSIZ.

LCEC.name: Encounter
LCEC.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/LCTN. The encounter: a worldspace and a run of int16 pairs.

LCEP.name: Enable Points
LCEP.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/LCTN. The enable points: a run of twelve-byte structs with no count of their own.

LCPR.name: Population Refs
LCPR.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/LCTN. The population refs: a run of twelve-byte structs with no count of their own.

LCSR.name: Static Refs
LCSR.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/LCTN. The static refs: a run of sixteen-byte structs with no count of their own.

LCUN.name: Unique Refs
LCUN.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/LCTN. The unique refs: a run of twelve-byte structs with no count of their own.

RCPR.name: Population References
RCPR.note: The actors. There is only one instance of this in the game data.

MISC.name: Miscellaneous
MISC.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/MISC. [measured: 13 MODS and 11 VMAD fields in Skyrim.esm]

DATA.name: Value & Weight Data
DATA.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/MISC. 8-Bytes For Value & Weight

FULL.name: Full Name
FULL.note: The name shown in the game.

ICON.name: Inventory Image
ICON.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/MISC. Inventory Image Filename

KSIZ.name: count
KSIZ.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/MISC. Number of formids in the following KWDA subrecord

KWDA.name: keywords
KWDA.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/MISC. Formid array of keywords

MICO.name: Message Immage
MICO.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/MISC. Message Immage Filename

MODL.name: Model
MODL.note: The model, with the MODT and MODS fields.

YNAM.name: pickupSound
YNAM.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/MISC. Sound(SNDR) played when picked up

ZNAM.name: dropSound
ZNAM.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/MISC. Sound(SNDR) played when dropped

PROJ.name: Projectile
PROJ.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/PROJ. [measured: 12 NAM2 fields in Skyrim.esm, 12 to 24 bytes]

NAM2.name: Muzzle Flash Model Texture Hashes
NAM2.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/PROJ. The muzzle flash's textures, in the same two forms as Skyrim's MODT.

REGN.name: Region
REGN.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/REGN. [measured: 53 RDSA fields in Skyrim.esm, 12 to 708 bytes]

RDOT.name: Owner Type
RDOT.note: The owner type. It is empty in Skyrim.esm. [observed: 0 bytes]

RDSA.name: Region Data
RDSA.note: The region's data, whose size varies with the region.

RDWT.name: Weight
RDWT.note: The region's weight, a run of floats. [measured: 12, 36, 48, 60, 72 or 84 bytes in Skyrim.esm]

RPLD.name: Region Points
RPLD.note: One area's polygon in worldspace units: x, y pairs [documented: xEdit wbRPLDAfterLoad reads each entry's two elements as numbers; observed: VMapGoodspringsRegion's six points span x -76216..-67372, y -6064..10250, around Goodsprings]

RELA.name: Relationship
RELA.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/RELA. [measured: 642 DATA fields in Skyrim.esm, each 16 bytes]

DATA.name: Data
DATA.note: The parent, the child, the rank, the flag and the association type.

REVB.name: Reverb
REVB.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/REVB. [measured: 10 DATA fields in Skyrim.esm, each 14 bytes]

SMQN.name: Story Manager Quest Node
SMQN.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/SMQN. [measured: 17 MNAM and 7 FNAM fields in Skyrim.esm, each 4 bytes]

CIS2.name: Variable Name
CIS2.note: An optional variable name, for example "::playerAllegiance_var".

DNAM.name: Flags
DNAM.note: The event's flags. 0x01 is known, and very large values such as 0x10000 and 0x100000 occur.

NNAM.name: Quest Node
NNAM.note: A QUST formid. There is one per QNAM, each optionally followed by an RNAM.

PNAM.name: Parent
PNAM.note: The parent SMQN, SMEN or SMBN.

RNAM.name: Reset Time
RNAM.note: The time until the reset. The CK shows the value divided by 24 and labelled as hours, which is probably days.

SNAM.name: Sibling
SNAM.note: Zero for the first child, or the prior sibling.

VOLI.name: Volume
VOLI.note: A volume is a grid of cells, each a form id. [measured: 36 VOLI records in Update.esm, each with twelve four-byte fields]

CNAM.name: Cell
CNAM.note: One cell of the volume's grid.

struct.name: flags
struct.note: Possibly flags, but not shown in the editor.

struct.name: training_skill
struct.note: The skill a trainer class teaches, given as an actor value index.

struct.name: training_level
struct.note: The level the trainer teaches to. Zero when the class does not train.

struct.name: skill_weights
struct.note: The weight of each skill, in actor value index order.

struct.name: owner
struct.note: The owner, a character (NPC_) or a faction (FACT).

struct.name: owner_rank
struct.note: The rank required in the faction for ownership, which is 0 or -1 when there is no faction.

struct.name: words
struct.note: The rest of the data, whose layout is not documented.

struct.name: walking
struct.note: The count of the walking set.

struct.name: running
struct.note: The count of the running set.

struct.name: sprinting
struct.note: The count of the sprinting set.

struct.name: sneaking
struct.note: The count of the sneaking set.

struct.name: swimming
struct.note: The count of the swimming set.

struct.name: extra
struct.note: Four more bytes, which vary though the first is always zero.

struct.name: cell_or_world
struct.note: The cell or worldspace, where 0x3C is Tamriel.

struct.name: cell_or_world
struct.note: The cell or worldspace, where 0x3C is Tamriel.

struct.name: location
struct.note: The location, which points to itself in most cases.

struct.name: parent
struct.note: The parent character. Parent and child here do not necessarily mean biological parent and child; it is a generic way of describing two connected items.

struct.name: rank
struct.note: The relationship level, from 0 to 8 in the data, which the game reads as -4 to 4.

struct.name: flags
struct.note: Only the highest bit is used.
